quote: Selain itu dengan pemberian pelet bisa diberikan secara terus menerus sedangkan pada pemberian Chlorella sp. dan Daphnia sp. hanya pemberian stok pada awal penebaran saja.
statement: Pelet dapat diberikan secara terus-menerus, sedangkan Chlorella sp. dan Daphnia sp. hanya diberikan sebagai stok pada awal penebaran.
text_en: Pelet dapat diberikan secara terus-menerus, sedangkan Chlorella sp. dan Daphnia sp. hanya diberikan sebagai stok pada awal penebaran.

quote: Sehingga di saat pakan alami tersebut mulai berkurang makan larva mulai mengalami pengurangan suplai makanan.
statement: Ketika pakan alami berkurang, larva mengalami pengurangan suplai makanan.
text_en: Ketika pakan alami berkurang, larva mengalami pengurangan suplai makanan.

quote: Selain itu larva yang kekurangan suplai makanan akan menjadi kanibal.
statement: Larva yang kekurangan suplai makanan akan menjadi kanibal.
text_en: Larva yang kekurangan suplai makanan akan menjadi kanibal.

quote: Perubahan warna yang muncul sedikit tidak jauh berbeda antara larva yang diberi pakan antara Chlorella sp. dan Daphnia sp. dengan pelet berupa pasta.
statement: Perubahan warna pada larva yang diberi Chlorella sp. dan Daphnia sp. tidak jauh berbeda dengan larva yang diberi pelet pasta.
text_en: Perubahan warna pada larva yang diberi Chlorella sp. dan Daphnia sp. tidak jauh berbeda dengan larva yang diberi pelet pasta.
intervention_record: 天然饵料与颗粒饲料对比

quote: Larva yang diberi Chlorella sp. dan Daphnia sp. warna lebih mencolok dari pada larva yang berbeda perlakuannya.
statement: Larva yang diberi makan Chlorella sp. dan Daphnia sp. memiliki warna yang lebih mencolok dibandingkan larva dengan perlakuan lain.
text_en: Larva yang diberi makan Chlorella sp. dan Daphnia sp. memiliki warna yang lebih mencolok dibandingkan larva dengan perlakuan lain.

quote: Hal ini bisa disebabkan larva tersebut mengalami pelambatan pada pertumbuhan namun memiliki kecepatan dalam menumbuhkan warna.
statement: Penyebab warna mencolok pada larva yang diberi pakan alami kemungkinan adalah pelambatan pertumbuhan tetapi kecepatan pembentukan warna.
text_en: Penyebab warna mencolok pada larva yang diberi pakan alami kemungkinan adalah pelambatan pertumbuhan tetapi kecepatan pembentukan warna.

quote: Pada pemberian pakan alami cenderung warna yang dihasilkan lebih cepat dibandingkan dengan pertumbuhannya.
statement: Pemberian pakan alami cenderung menghasilkan warna lebih cepat dibandingkan laju pertumbuhannya.
text_en: Pemberian pakan alami cenderung menghasilkan warna lebih cepat dibandingkan laju pertumbuhannya.

quote: Sedangkan pada pemberian pelet atau pakan buatan cenderung lebih mempercepat pertumbuhan.
statement: Pemberian pelet atau pakan buatan cenderung lebih mempercepat pertumbuhan.
text_en: Pemberian pelet atau pakan buatan cenderung lebih mempercepat pertumbuhan.

quote: Menurut Husnan et al. (2014), pakan Moina sp memberikan warna tubuh pada ikan komet paling cerah bila dibandingkan dengan pakan buatan dan Tubifex sp.
statement: Husnan et al. (2014) melaporkan bahwa pakan Moina sp memberikan warna tubuh paling cerah pada ikan komet dibandingkan pakan buatan dan Tubifex sp.
text_en: Husnan et al. (2014) melaporkan bahwa pakan Moina sp memberikan warna tubuh paling cerah pada ikan komet dibandingkan pakan buatan dan Tubifex sp.

quote: Warna tubuh ikan komet yang diberi pakan buatan lebih cerah bila bandingkan dengan pakan Tubifex sp.
statement: Warna tubuh ikan komet yang diberi pakan buatan lebih cerah dibandingkan yang diberi pakan Tubifex sp.
text_en: Warna tubuh ikan komet yang diberi pakan buatan lebih cerah dibandingkan yang diberi pakan Tubifex sp.

quote: Ikan komet yang diberi pakan Tubifex sp. warnanya lebih memudar.
statement: Ikan komet yang diberi pakan Tubifex sp. memiliki warna yang lebih memudar.
text_en: Ikan komet yang diberi pakan Tubifex sp. memiliki warna yang lebih memudar.

quote: Importantly, exogenous palmitate, threonine, and taurine slightly inhibit the TCA cycle and restore the altered innate immune responses repressed at the higher temperature.
statement: 外源性的棕榈酸、苏氨酸和牛磺酸能轻微抑制三羧酸循环，并恢复在高温下被抑制的先天免疫反应。
text_zh: 外源性的棕榈酸、苏氨酸和牛磺酸能轻微抑制三羧酸循环，并恢复在高温下被抑制的先天免疫反应。
text_en: Exogenous palmitic acid, threonine, and taurine can slightly inhibit the tricarboxylic acid cycle and restore the innate immune response that was suppressed under high temperatures.

quote: These results indicate that higher water temperature reduces the survival of crucian carps via metabolism, which can be reprogramed through crucial biomarkers.
statement: 结果表明较高的水温通过代谢途径降低了鲫鱼的存活率，这可以通过关键生物标志物进行重编程。
text_zh: 结果表明较高的水温通过代谢途径降低了鲫鱼的存活率，这可以通过关键生物标志物进行重编程。
text_en: The results showed that higher water temperature reduced the survival rate of crucian carp through metabolic pathways, which can be reprogrammed by key biomarkers.

quote: Then, C. carassius were challenged with E. tarda EIB202 with a dose of 10 μl 1 × 10 3 CFU per fish.
statement: 鲫鱼（C. carassius）被以每尾鱼10微升、浓度为1×10^3 CFU的剂量感染迟缓爱德华氏菌EIB202。
text_zh: 鲫鱼（C. carassius）被以每尾鱼10微升、浓度为1×10^3 CFU的剂量感染迟缓爱德华氏菌EIB202。
text_en: Crucian carp (C. carassius) were infected with Edwardsiella tarda EIB202 at a dose of 10 microliters per fish and a concentration of 1×10^3 CFU.

quote: Crucian carps (30.9±2.3 g; n = 40; 9.3–10.5°C) were exposed to different oxygen levels in the following six treatments: normoxia, 7 days of hypoxia, 1, 3 or 5 days of anoxia (post hypoxia), and 5 days reoxygenation (post 5 days of anoxia) in separate, dark tanks (minimum 1 l/fish).
statement: 鲫鱼被暴露于不同的氧气水平，包括常氧、缺氧、无氧和复氧处理，并在单独的暗水箱中饲养（最低每鱼1升）。
text_zh: 鲫鱼被暴露于不同的氧气水平，包括常氧、缺氧、无氧和复氧处理，并在单独的暗水箱中饲养（最低每鱼1升）。
text_en: Crucian carp were exposed to different oxygen levels, including normoxia, hypoxia, anoxia and reoxygenation treatments, and kept in separate dark tanks (minimum 1 liter per fish).

quote: Anoxic conditions were obtained by running the water through a narrow, 2 m high column bubbled with N 2 gas (AGA) before letting it into the experimental tanks (flow rate 4 l h −1).
statement: 通过将水通过充氮气的窄高柱后进入实验箱来获得无氧条件。
text_zh: 通过将水通过充氮气的窄高柱后进入实验箱来获得无氧条件。
text_en: Anoxic conditions were obtained by passing water through a narrow, tall column filled with nitrogen gas before entering the experimental tank.

quote: They were kept at the aquarium facility of the Department of Molecular Biosciences, University of Oslo, in tanks (100 fish/500 l) continuously supplied with aerated and dechlorinated Oslo tap water (17°C).
statement: 鲫鱼被饲养在持续供应充气和去氯自来水的鱼缸中，密度为每500升100条鱼，水温为17°C。
text_zh: 鲫鱼被饲养在持续供应充气和去氯自来水的鱼缸中，密度为每500升100条鱼，水温为17°C。
text_en: Crucian carp were reared in aquaria with a continuous supply of aerated and dechlorinated tap water, at a density of 100 fish per 500 liters, with a water temperature of 17°C.

quote: The fish were fed daily with commercial carp food and were acclimated to the experimental temperature for at least four weeks.
statement: 鱼类每天喂食商业鲤鱼饲料，并在实验温度下至少适应四周。
text_zh: 鱼类每天喂食商业鲤鱼饲料，并在实验温度下至少适应四周。
text_en: Fish were fed commercial carp feed daily and acclimated to the experimental temperature for at least four weeks.

quote: Fish were not fed during hypoxia or anoxia exposure.
statement: 在缺氧或无氧暴露期间不喂食鱼类。
text_zh: 在缺氧或无氧暴露期间不喂食鱼类。
text_en: Do not feed fish during hypoxic or anoxic exposure.

quote: At the time of sampling, 8 to 10 fish were killed by a sharp blow to the head and subsequent cutting of the spinal cord.
statement: 采样时，通过重击头部并随后切断脊髓的方式处死8至10条鱼。
text_zh: 采样时，通过重击头部并随后切断脊髓的方式处死8至10条鱼。
text_en: At sampling, 8 to 10 fish were euthanized by a sharp blow to the head followed by cutting of the spinal cord.

quote: That temperature shift alters the immune status of Cyprinus carpio advanced fingerlings, while persistent sub-lethal exposure to chlorine augments temperature induced immunosuppression (26).
statement: 温度变化改变了鲤鱼大规格鱼种的免疫状态，而持续亚致死剂量的氯暴露加剧了温度诱导的免疫抑制。
text_zh: 温度变化改变了鲤鱼大规格鱼种的免疫状态，而持续亚致死剂量的氯暴露加剧了温度诱导的免疫抑制。
text_en: Temperature changes altered the immune status of large-sized common carp fingerlings, and continuous exposure to sublethal doses of chlorine exacerbated temperature-induced immunosuppression.

quote: Multiple acute temperature stress affects leucocyte populations and antibody responses in the common carp, Cyprinus carpio L . (27).
statement: 多次急性温度应激影响鲤鱼的白细胞群和抗体反应。
text_zh: 多次急性温度应激影响鲤鱼的白细胞群和抗体反应。
text_en: Multiple acute temperature stress affects the leukocyte population and antibody response of carp.

quote: L-Proline, a crucial biomarker identified from temperature shift, increased the survival of tilapias infected by Streptococcus agalactiae in high water temperature (39).
statement: L-脯氨酸增加了高温下感染无乳链球菌的罗非鱼的存活率。
text_zh: L-脯氨酸增加了高温下感染无乳链球菌的罗非鱼的存活率。
text_en: L-proline increased the survival rate of tilapia infected with Streptococcus agalactiae under high temperature.

quote: The first core finding in the present study showed that high temperature disrupts the normal flow of the TCA cycle, making the host vulnerable to bacterial infection.
statement: 高温破坏三羧酸循环的正常流动，使宿主易受细菌感染。
text_zh: 高温破坏三羧酸循环的正常流动，使宿主易受细菌感染。
text_en: High temperature disrupts the normal flow of the tricarboxylic acid cycle, making hosts susceptible to bacterial infection.

quote: More importantly, the inhibition of the TCA cycle promoted fish survival during bacterial infection.
statement: 抑制三羧酸循环促进了鱼在细菌感染期间的存活。
text_zh: 抑制三羧酸循环促进了鱼在细菌感染期间的存活。
text_en: Inhibiting the tricarboxylic acid cycle promoted fish survival during bacterial infection.

quote: C. carassius was normally reared in 50 L water tanks equipped with Closed Recirculating Aquaculture Systems, and the maintaining physico-chemical parameters were: dissolved oxygen: 6–7 mg/L
statement: 鲫鱼通常在配备循环水养殖系统的50升水箱中饲养，溶解氧维持在6-7毫克/升。
text_zh: 鲫鱼通常在配备循环水养殖系统的50升水箱中饲养，溶解氧维持在6-7毫克/升。
text_en: Crucian carp are typically raised in 50-liter tanks equipped with a recirculating aquaculture system, with dissolved oxygen maintained at 6-7 mg/L.

quote: the water temperature was gradually changed until the fish were adapted to constant temperature at 20 or 30°C.
statement: 水温被逐渐改变，直到鱼适应20或30摄氏度的恒定温度。
text_zh: 水温被逐渐改变，直到鱼适应20或30摄氏度的恒定温度。
text_en: Water temperature was gradually changed until the fish adapted to a constant temperature of 20 or 30 degrees Celsius.

quote: The water quality was monitored regularly.
statement: 水质被定期监测。
text_zh: 水质被定期监测。
text_en: Water quality is regularly monitored.

quote: each C. carassius cultured at 20 or 30°C was intraperitoneally injected with 10 μl 1 × 10 5 CFU bacterial suspension or saline only
statement: 在20或30摄氏度下培养的每条鲫鱼均腹腔注射了10微升含1×10^5 CFU的细菌悬浮液或仅生理盐水。
text_zh: 在20或30摄氏度下培养的每条鲫鱼均腹腔注射了10微升含1×10^5 CFU的细菌悬浮液或仅生理盐水。
text_en: Each crucian carp cultured at 20 or 30 degrees Celsius was intraperitoneally injected with 10 microliters of a bacterial suspension containing 1×10^5 CFU or saline only.

quote: These crucian carps were observed for symptoms twice daily for 15 days for accumulative death.
statement: 这些鲫鱼每天观察两次症状，持续15天以记录累积死亡情况。
text_zh: 这些鲫鱼每天观察两次症状，持续15天以记录累积死亡情况。
text_en: These crucian carp were observed for symptoms twice daily for 15 days to record cumulative mortality.

quote: C. carassius cultured at 20 or 30°C were euthanized in ice slush (5 parts ice/1 part water, 0–4°C) for at least 10 min following cessation of gill movement, and left in the ice water for a total of 20 min after cessation of all movement to ensure death by hypoxia following the guidelines of NIH.
statement: 在20或30摄氏度下培养的鲫鱼在冰水混合物（5份冰/1份水，0-4摄氏度）中被安乐死至少10分钟，直至鳃运动停止，并在所有运动停止后继续在冰水中放置总共20分钟，以确保因缺氧而死亡，遵循NIH指南。
text_zh: 在20或30摄氏度下培养的鲫鱼在冰水混合物（5份冰/1份水，0-4摄氏度）中被安乐死至少10分钟，直至鳃运动停止，并在所有运动停止后继续在冰水中放置总共20分钟，以确保因缺氧而死亡，遵循NIH指南。
text_en: Crucian carp cultured at 20 or 30 degrees Celsius were euthanized in an ice-water mixture (5 parts ice/1 part water, 0-4 degrees Celsius) for at least 10 minutes until gill movement ceased, and kept in the ice water for a total of 20 minutes after all movement stopped to ensure death due to hypoxia, following NIH guidelines.

quote: These results suggested that exogenous taurine and palmitic acid may downregulate TCA cycle to promote C. carassius survival from E. tarda infection at 30°C.
statement: 结果表明外源牛磺酸和棕榈酸可能通过下调三羧酸循环来促进鲫鱼在30°C下抵抗爱德华氏菌感染的存活。
text_zh: 结果表明外源牛磺酸和棕榈酸可能通过下调三羧酸循环来促进鲫鱼在30°C下抵抗爱德华氏菌感染的存活。
text_en: The results indicate that exogenous taurine and palmitic acid may promote the survival of crucian carp against Edwardsiella infection at 30°C by downregulating the tricarboxylic acid cycle.

quote: C. carassius (n = 330) was randomly divided into five groups, including three metabolite groups (n = 90 per group), and two control groups (n = 30 per group), and acclimatized for 7 days at 30°C.
statement: 鲫鱼被随机分为五组，并在30°C下适应7天。
text_zh: 鲫鱼被随机分为五组，并在30°C下适应7天。
text_en: Crucian carp were randomly divided into five groups and acclimated at 30°C for 7 days.

quote: Afterwards, C. carassius was challenged by intraperitoneal injection of E. tarda EIB202 with a dose of 10 μl 1 × 10 5 CFU/fish, and the fish mortality was observed for 15 days for accumulative death.
statement: 随后通过腹腔注射迟缓爱德华氏菌对鲫鱼进行攻毒，并观察15天的累积死亡率。
text_zh: 随后通过腹腔注射迟缓爱德华氏菌对鲫鱼进行攻毒，并观察15天的累积死亡率。
text_en: Subsequently, crucian carp were challenged by intraperitoneal injection of Edwardsiella tarda, and cumulative mortality was observed for 15 days.

quote: The state of well-being of the fish was estimated by means of the relative condition factor (Kn) using the following formula, Kn= W‟/W (Le Cren, 1951), where W‟= the observed weight of each individual and W= the expected weight using the length-weight relationship.
statement: 鱼的健康状况通过相对条件因子（Kn）进行估算，该因子基于实测体重与根据长度-重量关系预测的体重之比。
text_zh: 鱼的健康状况通过相对条件因子（Kn）进行估算，该因子基于实测体重与根据长度-重量关系预测的体重之比。
text_en: The health status of fish is estimated by the relative condition factor (Kn), which is based on the ratio of measured weight to predicted weight according to the length-weight relationship.

quote: These results indicated that the three crucial biomarkers regulate innate immune response to fight against the infection at 30°C.
statement: 结果表明这三种关键生物标志物调节了在30°C下对抗感染的先天免疫反应。
text_zh: 结果表明这三种关键生物标志物调节了在30°C下对抗感染的先天免疫反应。
text_en: The results showed that these three key biomarkers modulated the innate immune response against infection at 30°C.

quote: Environmental temperature affects fish host immune responses to microbial infection (44).
statement: 环境温度影响鱼类宿主对微生物感染的免疫反应。
text_zh: 环境温度影响鱼类宿主对微生物感染的免疫反应。
text_en: Ambient temperature affects the immune response of fish hosts to microbial infections.

quote: Several endemic diseases of salmonids are more prevalent and difficult to control with the increase of water temperature (44).
statement: 随着水温升高，鲑科鱼类的几种地方性流行病变得更加普遍且难以控制。
text_zh: 随着水温升高，鲑科鱼类的几种地方性流行病变得更加普遍且难以控制。
text_en: As water temperature rises, several endemic diseases in salmonid fish become more prevalent and harder to control.

quote: One reason is that the increase in water temperatures are likely to enhance the susceptibility of fish to disease and the likelihood of disease emergence (44).
statement: 原因之一是水温升高可能会增强鱼类对疾病的易感性以及疾病出现的可能性。
text_zh: 原因之一是水温升高可能会增强鱼类对疾病的易感性以及疾病出现的可能性。
text_en: One of the reasons is that increased water temperature may enhance fish susceptibility to diseases and the likelihood of disease occurrence.

quote: Specimens were caught by means of electrofishing equipment (provides 150-300V) and three types of nets.
statement: 样本通过提供150-300伏特的电捕鱼设备和三种类型的网具捕获。
text_zh: 样本通过提供150-300伏特的电捕鱼设备和三种类型的网具捕获。
text_en: Samples were captured using electrofishing equipment providing 150-300 volts and three types of nets.

quote: The seasonal trend in the feeding activity of C. auratus in the present study is related with water temperature (r= 0.928), the highest value of the criterion was recorded in summer and the lowest one in winter.
statement: 本研究中鲤鲫摄食活动的季节变化与水温相关，夏季最高，冬季最低。
text_zh: 本研究中鲤鲫摄食活动的季节变化与水温相关，夏季最高，冬季最低。
text_en: In this study, the seasonal variation in feeding activity of common carp and crucian carp was correlated with water temperature, being highest in summer and lowest in winter.

quote: It is generally known that feeding activity of Cyprinids decreases with decreasing of the water temperature (Penttinen and Holopainen 1992).
statement: 通常认为鲤科鱼类的摄食活动随水温降低而减少。
text_zh: 通常认为鲤科鱼类的摄食活动随水温降低而减少。
text_en: It is generally believed that the feeding activity of cyprinid fish decreases as water temperature drops.

quote: The condition factor in fish serves as a measure of the physiological state of fish in relation to their health, and reflects physical and biological circum-stances and fluctuations by interaction among feeding conditions, parasitic infections and repro-ductive cycle (Narejo et al., 2002; De Giosa et al., 2014).
statement: 鱼类的肥满度是衡量鱼类生理状态及其健康状况的指标，反映了摄食条件、寄生虫感染和繁殖周期之间相互作用下的物理和生物环境及波动。
text_zh: 鱼类的肥满度是衡量鱼类生理状态及其健康状况的指标，反映了摄食条件、寄生虫感染和繁殖周期之间相互作用下的物理和生物环境及波动。
text_en: Fish condition factor is an indicator of the physiological state and health status of fish, reflecting the physical and biological environment and fluctuations under the interaction of feeding conditions, parasite infection, and reproductive cycles.

quote: At 280 days after hatching, growth of three treatment groups (control, 0.01 and 10.0 mg/L) reared at 30°C was signiﬁcantly greater in com- parison to the respective cohort treatment groups at 24°C.
statement: 在孵化后280天，与24°C组相比，30°C饲养的三个处理组（对照、0.01和10.0 mg/L）的生长显著更大。
text_zh: 在孵化后280天，与24°C组相比，30°C饲养的三个处理组（对照、0.01和10.0 mg/L）的生长显著更大。
text_en: At 280 days post-hatching, growth was significantly greater in the three treatment groups (control, 0.01 and 10.0 mg/L) reared at 30°C compared to the 24°C group.

quote: Hatched larvae were reared in 30 L tanks at 19.5 ± 1.5°C and fed Brachionus spp. and Moina spp. for 20 days after hatching.
statement: 孵化后的幼虫在19.5 ± 1.5°C的30升水箱中饲养，并在孵化后20天内投喂轮虫属和溞属。
text_zh: 孵化后的幼虫在19.5 ± 1.5°C的30升水箱中饲养，并在孵化后20天内投喂轮虫属和溞属。
text_en: Larvae after hatching were reared in 30-liter tanks at 19.5 ± 1.5°C and fed rotifers (Rotifera) and cladocerans (Cladocera) for 20 days post-hatching.

quote: Ten cohorts of 150 fry at 20 days posthatching (11.4 ± 0.5 mm in total length; mean ± SE) were kept in separate tanks (30 L) with 20 L of well-aerated water under natural photoperiod.
statement: 十批在孵化后20天的鱼苗（全长11.4 ± 0.5毫米；平均值±标准误）被分别保存在装有20升充分曝气水的独立水箱（30升）中，处于自然光周期下。
text_zh: 十批在孵化后20天的鱼苗（全长11.4 ± 0.5毫米；平均值±标准误）被分别保存在装有20升充分曝气水的独立水箱（30升）中，处于自然光周期下。
text_en: Ten batches of fry (20 days post-hatching; total length 11.4 ± 0.5 mm; mean ± standard error) were kept separately in individual tanks (30 L) containing 20 L of well-aerated water under a natural photoperiod.

quote: The feeding activity of the spe- cies ranged from 30% in February to 91% in April. In general, both feeding were low during winter and high during summer.
statement: 鲫鱼（C. auratus）的摄食活动在2月为30%，在4月达到91%，总体上冬季摄食低而夏季摄食高。
text_zh: 鲫鱼（C. auratus）的摄食活动在2月为30%，在4月达到91%，总体上冬季摄食低而夏季摄食高。

quote: The contribution of crustacean in the diet fluctuat- ed from 1.7% in April to 9.0% in October.
statement: 甲壳类动物在饮食中的贡献从4月的1.7%波动到10月的9.0%。
text_zh: 甲壳类动物在饮食中的贡献从4月的1.7%波动到10月的9.0%。

quote: Five isonitrogenous (35%) diets with different lipid contents were prepared by adding 0%, 3%, 6%, 9%, and 12% soybean oil (SO) as the single lipid source (with groups designated SO0, SO3, SO6, SO9, and SO12, respectively), followed by a 12‐week feeding experiment in juvenile gibel carp (Carassius gibelio) (initial weight: 11.76 ± 0.09 g).
statement: 研究制备了五种等氮（35%）饲料，分别添加0%、3%、6%、9%和12%的豆油作为单一脂质来源，并在初始体重为11.76 ± 0.09克的银鲫幼鱼中进行了为期12周的饲养实验。
text_zh: 研究制备了五种等氮（35%）饲料，分别添加0%、3%、6%、9%和12%的豆油作为单一脂质来源，并在初始体重为11.76 ± 0.09克的银鲫幼鱼中进行了为期12周的饲养实验。
text_en: Five isonitrogenous (35%) diets were prepared, with 0%, 3%, 6%, 9% and 12% soybean oil added as the sole lipid source, and a 12-week feeding trial was conducted in juvenile silver crucian carp with an initial body weight of 11.76 ± 0.09 g.
intervention: Diets with graded soybean oil levels

quote: Fat and the relevant components of dietary lipids, such as phospholipids and sterols, not only provide essential fatty acids, energy substrates, and spare dietary protein, but also participate in physiological processes in fish; both of these factors influence fish growth, health, and flesh quality [ 4 – 6 ].
statement: 脂肪及其相关成分（如磷脂和固醇）不仅提供必需脂肪酸、能量底物和节约膳食蛋白，还参与鱼类的生理过程；这两个因素均影响鱼类的生长、健康和肉质品质。
text_zh: 脂肪及其相关成分（如磷脂和固醇）不仅提供必需脂肪酸、能量底物和节约膳食蛋白，还参与鱼类的生理过程；这两个因素均影响鱼类的生长、健康和肉质品质。
text_en: Lipids and their related components (such as phospholipids and sterols) not only provide essential fatty acids, energy substrates, and spare dietary protein, but also participate in the physiological processes of fish; both factors affect fish growth, health, and flesh quality.

quote: Three muscle samples were clipped from the dorsal sides of three gibel carp in each tank, mixed as one representative sample, and evaluated in the relevant assays of nutritional composition.
statement: 从每个水箱中的三条银鲫背部剪取三个肌肉样本，混合为一个代表性样本，用于营养成分相关测定。
text_zh: 从每个水箱中的三条银鲫背部剪取三个肌肉样本，混合为一个代表性样本，用于营养成分相关测定。
text_en: Three muscle samples were cut from the backs of three silver crucian carp in each tank, mixed into one representative sample, and used for nutritional composition-related measurements.

quote: diets featuring SO as the sole lipid source were formulated and implemented to systematically assess how SO–based diets with different lipid contents affect the growth, flesh nutrition, physio–biochemical indicators, molecular responses, and transcriptome characteristics related to hepatic lipid metabolism in juvenile gibel carp “CAS III,”
statement: 研究通过配制以豆油为唯一脂质来源且脂质含量不同的饲料，系统评估其对异育银鲫“中科3号”幼鱼生长、肉质营养、生理生化指标及肝脏脂质代谢相关分子反应和转录组特征的影响。
text_zh: 研究通过配制以豆油为唯一脂质来源且脂质含量不同的饲料，系统评估其对异育银鲫“中科3号”幼鱼生长、肉质营养、生理生化指标及肝脏脂质代谢相关分子反应和转录组特征的影响。
text_en: The study systematically evaluated the effects of diets formulated with soybean oil as the sole lipid source and varying in lipid content on the growth, flesh nutritional quality, physiological and biochemical indicators, molecular responses related to hepatic lipid metabolism, and transcriptomic characteristics of juvenile allogynogenetic gibel carp 'Zhongke No. 3'.

population.species: 异育银鲫“中科3号” (gibel carp “CAS III”)

intervention: Soybean oil as sole lipid source
outcome: 生长性能与肝脏脂质代谢

quote: Furthermore, the common tendency to employ a higher content of dietary lipids in aquafeeds has generated controversy, with drawbacks including growth hindrance, lower feed intake, abnormal hepatic lipid deposition, and poor nutritional value
statement: 在水产饲料中使用较高含量的膳食脂质这一常见趋势引发了争议，其缺点包括生长受阻、采食量降低、肝脏脂质沉积异常以及营养价值低。
text_zh: 在水产饲料中使用较高含量的膳食脂质这一常见趋势引发了争议，其缺点包括生长受阻、采食量降低、肝脏脂质沉积异常以及营养价值低。
text_en: The common trend of using higher levels of dietary lipids in aquaculture feed has sparked controversy, with disadvantages including stunted growth, reduced feed intake, abnormal hepatic lipid deposition, and low nutritional value.

quote: Serum ALT and AST activities were diminished to varying degrees in response to an increase in dietary SO from 0% to 9% (p 1), while their levels in the SO12 group returned to near to or higher than those of the control (i.e., SO0) (p 1).
statement: 随着饲料中豆油（SO）含量从0%增加到9%，血清ALT和AST活性不同程度降低，但在SO12组中恢复至接近或高于对照组水平。
text_zh: 随着饲料中豆油（SO）含量从0%增加到9%，血清ALT和AST活性不同程度降低，但在SO12组中恢复至接近或高于对照组水平。
text_en: As the soybean oil (SO) content in the feed increased from 0% to 9%, serum ALT and AST activities decreased to varying degrees, but in the SO12 group they recovered to levels close to or higher than those of the control group.

quote: No unfavorable growth performance, immune response, or antioxidant effects have been reported for multiple fishes (especially freshwater species) [ 7 , 11 – 13 ] after the full replacement of FO with SO.
statement: 据报道，在多种鱼类（特别是淡水物种）中，用大豆油完全替代鱼油后未观察到不良的生长性能、免疫反应或抗氧化效应。
text_zh: 据报道，在多种鱼类（特别是淡水物种）中，用大豆油完全替代鱼油后未观察到不良的生长性能、免疫反应或抗氧化效应。
text_en: It is reported that in various fish species (particularly freshwater species), no adverse effects on growth performance, immune response, or antioxidant status were observed after complete replacement of fish oil with soybean oil.

population.species: 多种鱼类（特别是淡水物种）

intervention: Soybean oil as sole lipid source
outcome: 生长性能、免疫反应、抗氧化能力

quote: Nevertheless, excessive n‐6 FA intake is hazardous to marine fish health, causing attenuated immunity, increased inflammatory and oxidative stress, weakened disease resistance, etc.
statement: 过量的n-6脂肪酸摄入对海水鱼的健康有害，会导致免疫力减弱、炎症和氧化应激增加以及抗病能力下降。
text_zh: 过量的n-6脂肪酸摄入对海水鱼的健康有害，会导致免疫力减弱、炎症和氧化应激增加以及抗病能力下降。
text_en: Excessive intake of n-6 fatty acids is harmful to the health of marine fish, leading to weakened immunity, increased inflammation and oxidative stress, and decreased disease resistance.
outcome: 免疫功能、炎症水平、氧化应激、疾病抵抗力

quote: It is also attributed to an imbalance in the n‐3/n‐6 PUFA ratio [ 10 ] or relatively low dietary n‐3 PUFA contents; both are caused by SO and other vegetable oils containing high doses of n‐6 FAs.
statement: 这也归因于n-3/n-6多不饱和脂肪酸比例失衡或饮食中n-3多不饱和脂肪酸含量相对较低，这两者均由含有高剂量n-6脂肪酸的大豆油和其他植物油引起。
text_zh: 这也归因于n-3/n-6多不饱和脂肪酸比例失衡或饮食中n-3多不饱和脂肪酸含量相对较低，这两者均由含有高剂量n-6脂肪酸的大豆油和其他植物油引起。
text_en: This is also attributed to an imbalance in the n-3/n-6 polyunsaturated fatty acid ratio or a relatively low content of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids in the diet, both caused by soybean oil and other vegetable oils containing high doses of n-6 fatty acids.

quote: Healthy juvenile gibel carp (Carassius gibelio var. CAS III) were purchased from Huandun fishery (Lianyungang, China) and cultured in the indoor flow‐through system located in Jiangsu Key Laboratory of Marine Biotechnology, Jiangsu Ocean University (Lianyungang, China) for a 2‐week acclimation period.
statement: 健康异育银鲫幼鱼在室内流水系统中进行了为期两周的驯化。
text_zh: 健康异育银鲫幼鱼在室内流水系统中进行了为期两周的驯化。
text_en: Healthy juvenile gibel carp (Carassius auratus gibelio) were acclimated for two weeks in an indoor flow-through system.

population.species: gibel carp (Carassius gibelio var. CAS III)

quote: Juveniles were fed the SO0 diet (i.e., the control diet supplemented with 0% SO) to satiation four times per day (8:00, 11:00, 14:00, and 17:00) in the acclimation phase.
statement: 在驯化阶段，幼鱼每天四次投喂对照饲料至饱食。
text_zh: 在驯化阶段，幼鱼每天四次投喂对照饲料至饱食。
text_en: During the acclimation phase, juvenile fish were fed the control diet to satiation four times daily.

population.species: gibel carp (Carassius gibelio var. CAS III)

quote: At the initiation of the feeding study, 450 gibel carp (body weight: 11.74 ± 0.08 g) were randomly distributed into 15 tanks with 240 L (i.e., 30 fish/tank, 3 replicates/group, 5 groups in total).
statement: 实验开始时，将450尾体长约11.74克的异育银鲫随机分配到15个240升的水箱中，每箱30尾。
text_zh: 实验开始时，将450尾体长约11.74克的异育银鲫随机分配到15个240升的水箱中，每箱30尾。
text_en: At the start of the experiment, 450 allogynogenetic gibel carp with a body length of about 11.74 grams were randomly assigned to 15 water tanks of 240 liters, with 30 fish per tank.

population.species: gibel carp (Carassius gibelio var. CAS III)

quote: Experimental fish were hand‐fed the corresponding diets four times daily to full satiation for 12 weeks.
statement: 实验鱼每天人工投喂相应饲料四次至饱食，持续12周。
text_zh: 实验鱼每天人工投喂相应饲料四次至饱食，持续12周。
text_en: The experimental fish were manually fed the corresponding feed four times a day to satiation for 12 weeks.

population.species: gibel carp (Carassius gibelio var. CAS III)

quote: When increasing the SO content from 0% to 12%, FCR and HSI initially decreased and then increased, achieving the minimum in the SO6 group (p 3).
statement: 当豆油含量从0%增加到12%时，饲料系数（FCR）和肝体指数（HSI）先降低后升高，在SO6组达到最低值。
text_zh: 当豆油含量从0%增加到12%时，饲料系数（FCR）和肝体指数（HSI）先降低后升高，在SO6组达到最低值。
text_en: When the soybean oil content increased from 0% to 12%, the feed conversion ratio (FCR) and hepatosomatic index (HSI) first decreased and then increased, reaching the lowest values in the SO6 group.
intervention: Diets with graded soybean oil levels

quote: As for survival rate (SR), no obvious differences were observed in fish among all groups (p > 0.05; Table 3).
statement: 关于存活率（SR），各组之间的鱼没有观察到明显差异。
text_zh: 关于存活率（SR），各组之间的鱼没有观察到明显差异。
text_en: Regarding survival rate (SR), no significant difference was observed among the fish in the different groups.
intervention: Diets with graded soybean oil levels

quote: The water environment of the flow‐through system was maintained as follows: water temperature, 20–25°C; dissolved oxygen >5 mg/L; pH 7–8; ammonia nitrogen 2.3.
statement: 流水系统的水环境维持如下：水温20-25°C；溶解氧>5 mg/L；pH 7-8；氨氮2.3。
text_zh: 流水系统的水环境维持如下：水温20-25°C；溶解氧>5 mg/L；pH 7-8；氨氮2.3。
text_en: The water environment in the flow-through system is maintained as follows: water temperature 20-25°C; dissolved oxygen >5 mg/L; pH 7-8; ammonia nitrogen 2.3.

quote: Nine gibel carp in each tank were randomly netted, fully anesthetized under 20 mg/L MS‐222 (Merck KgaA, Darmstadt, Germany), and individually measured for body weight and body length.
statement: 每个水箱随机网捕九条银鲫，在20 mg/L MS-222下完全麻醉，并单独测量体重和体长。
text_zh: 每个水箱随机网捕九条银鲫，在20 mg/L MS-222下完全麻醉，并单独测量体重和体长。
text_en: Nine silver crucian carp were randomly netted from each tank, completely anesthetized in 20 mg/L MS-222, and their body weight and body length were measured individually.

quote: Blood was acquired from the tail vein of each fish and immediately centrifuged (3000 rpm, 4°C, 10 min) to harvest the supernatant, which was cryopreserved at − 80°C until serum detection.
statement: 从每条鱼的尾静脉采血，立即离心（3000 rpm，4°C，10分钟）以收获上清液，并在-80°C冷冻保存直至血清检测。
text_zh: 从每条鱼的尾静脉采血，立即离心（3000 rpm，4°C，10分钟）以收获上清液，并在-80°C冷冻保存直至血清检测。
text_en: Blood was collected from the caudal vein of each fish, immediately centrifuged (3000 rpm, 4°C, 10 minutes) to harvest the supernatant, and stored frozen at -80°C until serum testing.

quote: high levels of n‐6 PUFA‐enriched SO and other plant oils hamper growth and exacerbate fat deposition in aquatic animals
statement: 高含量的富含n-6多不饱和脂肪酸的豆油和其他植物油会阻碍水生动物生长并加剧脂肪沉积。
text_zh: 高含量的富含n-6多不饱和脂肪酸的豆油和其他植物油会阻碍水生动物生长并加剧脂肪沉积。
text_en: High levels of soybean oil and other vegetable oils rich in n-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids hinder the growth of aquatic animals and exacerbate fat deposition.

quote: growth impediment and fatty liver will likely occur in gibel carp if dietary SO addition further increases
statement: 如果进一步增加日粮中的豆油添加量，银鲫可能会出现生长受阻和脂肪肝。
text_zh: 如果进一步增加日粮中的豆油添加量，银鲫可能会出现生长受阻和脂肪肝。
text_en: If the soybean oil inclusion level in the diet is further increased, silver crucian carp may experience growth retardation and fatty liver.
intervention: Diets with graded soybean oil levels

quote: following administration of SO‐ or other plant oil‐based feeds, no significant alterations in growth parameters have been reported in some fish, regardless of the dietary fat level
statement: 在喂食豆油或其他植物油基饲料后，无论日粮脂肪水平如何，一些鱼类的生长参数均未报告有显著变化。
text_zh: 在喂食豆油或其他植物油基饲料后，无论日粮脂肪水平如何，一些鱼类的生长参数均未报告有显著变化。
text_en: After feeding soybean oil or other vegetable oil-based diets, no significant changes in growth parameters were reported for some fish species, regardless of dietary fat levels.

quote: Hepatopancreatic vacuolation was observed in all treatments, and its presence increased with the contents of dietary SO addition, particularly in the SO9 and SO12 groups (Figure 2 , Supporting Information 2 : Figure S4).
statement: 在所有处理组中均观察到肝胰腺空泡化，且其存在程度随饲料豆油添加量的增加而加剧，特别是在SO9和SO12组中。
text_zh: 在所有处理组中均观察到肝胰腺空泡化，且其存在程度随饲料豆油添加量的增加而加剧，特别是在SO9和SO12组中。
text_en: Hepatopancreatic vacuolization was observed in all treatment groups, and its severity increased with the level of dietary soybean oil supplementation, particularly in the SO9 and SO12 groups.

quote: More obvious inflammatory and hemorrhage phenomena were found within the central veins and hepatic sinusoids after the supplementation of 9%–12% dietary SO (Figure 2).
statement: 补充9%-12%饲料豆油后，中央静脉和肝血窦内发现更明显的炎症和出血现象。
text_zh: 补充9%-12%饲料豆油后，中央静脉和肝血窦内发现更明显的炎症和出血现象。
text_en: After supplementing with 9%-12% soybean oil in the feed, more obvious inflammation and hemorrhage were found in the central vein and hepatic sinusoids.

quote: This amount could facilitate superior growth and fish health and lead to better‐quality fish meat.
statement: 该添加量可能促进更优的生长和鱼类健康，并导致更好的鱼肉品质。
text_zh: 该添加量可能促进更优的生长和鱼类健康，并导致更好的鱼肉品质。
text_en: This inclusion level may promote better growth and fish health, and result in better fish meat quality.

quote: Excess dietary fats can be discharged into the blood, leading to a dose‐dependent elevation of TG/T‐CHO accumulation in serum, and can also impair lipoprotein synthesis/secretion or FA degradation, ultimately triggering a detrimental loop of lipotoxicity
statement: 过量膳食脂肪会导致血清中甘油三酯和总胆固醇剂量依赖性升高，并损害脂蛋白合成或脂肪酸降解，从而引发脂毒性。
text_zh: 过量膳食脂肪会导致血清中甘油三酯和总胆固醇剂量依赖性升高，并损害脂蛋白合成或脂肪酸降解，从而引发脂毒性。
text_en: Excess dietary fat causes a dose-dependent increase in serum triglycerides and total cholesterol, and impairs lipoprotein synthesis or fatty acid degradation, thereby inducing lipotoxicity.

quote: Overall, excessive lipid levels in SO–based diets likely disrupt the subtle lipid metabolism balance and lead to more fat deposition and even fat over‐accumulation in the hepatopancreas of gibel carp, in agreement with previous reports [ 7 , 50 , 60 ].
statement: 总体而言，基于豆油的日粮中过高的脂质水平可能破坏微妙的脂质代谢平衡，并导致异育银鲫肝胰腺中更多的脂肪沉积甚至脂肪过度积累。
text_zh: 总体而言，基于豆油的日粮中过高的脂质水平可能破坏微妙的脂质代谢平衡，并导致异育银鲫肝胰腺中更多的脂肪沉积甚至脂肪过度积累。
text_en: Overall, excessively high lipid levels in soybean oil-based diets may disrupt the delicate lipid metabolic balance and lead to more fat deposition or even excessive fat accumulation in the hepatopancreas of gibel carp.

quote: Given the findings of the above‐detected parameters and the detrimental effects of excessive dietary fat reported in farmed fish and fish products [ 19 , 23 , 30 , 61 ], hepatopancreases of the SO0 and SO12 groups were used to further investigate the molecular changes in gibel carp induced by high SO contents at the transcriptome level.
statement: Excessive dietary fat has been reported to have detrimental effects on farmed fish and fish products.
text_en: Excessive dietary fat has been reported to have detrimental effects on farmed fish and fish products.

quote: These data partially support the growth phenotypes described earlier, and somewhat validate the growth‐promoting effect in fishes induced by higher‐dietary‐fat supplements or short‐term HFDs [ 7 , 23 , 25 , 51 , 61 ].
statement: Higher dietary fat supplements or short-term high-fat diets (HFDs) can induce a growth-promoting effect in fishes.
text_en: Higher dietary fat supplements or short-term high-fat diets (HFDs) can induce a growth-promoting effect in fishes.

quote: Feeds supplemented with less than 3% SO as a single fat source might fail to meet growth and metabolic demands in juvenile gibel carp
statement: 以豆油为单一脂肪来源且添加量低于3%的饲料可能无法满足银鲫幼鱼的生长和代谢需求。
text_zh: 以豆油为单一脂肪来源且添加量低于3%的饲料可能无法满足银鲫幼鱼的生长和代谢需求。
text_en: Diets with soybean oil as the sole lipid source and at inclusion levels below 3% may not meet the growth and metabolic requirements of juvenile silver crucian carp.
intervention: Low-dose soybean oil as sole lipid
intervention_record: 低剂量豆油单一脂肪源

quote: Fish fed diets containing 12% SO exhibited less feed utilization and muscle protein deposition, higher muscle lipid accumulation and n‐6 PUFA contents, and abnormal phenotypes regarding hepatopancreas histology and serum parameters, which in turn had negative effects on flesh nutrition and fish health.
statement: 饲喂含12%豆油日粮的鱼表现出较低的饲料利用率和肌肉蛋白沉积、较高的肌肉脂质积累和n-6多不饱和脂肪酸含量，以及肝胰腺组织学和血清参数方面的异常表型，进而对肉质营养和鱼类健康产生负面影响。
text_zh: 饲喂含12%豆油日粮的鱼表现出较低的饲料利用率和肌肉蛋白沉积、较高的肌肉脂质积累和n-6多不饱和脂肪酸含量，以及肝胰腺组织学和血清参数方面的异常表型，进而对肉质营养和鱼类健康产生负面影响。
text_en: Fish fed a diet containing 12% soybean oil exhibited lower feed utilization and muscle protein deposition, higher muscle lipid accumulation and n-6 polyunsaturated fatty acid content, and abnormal phenotypes in hepatopancreas histology and serum parameters, thereby negatively affecting the nutritional quality of the flesh and fish health.
outcome: 饲料利用率、肌肉成分、肝胰腺组织学、血清参数及整体健康

quote: Clonally reproducing females of C. gibelio suffer from higher parasite loads when compared to the genetically variable sexual form which is expected to escape the parasite infection.
statement: 与遗传可变的有性生殖形式相比，克隆繁殖的银鲫雌性遭受更高的寄生虫负荷。
text_zh: 与遗传可变的有性生殖形式相比，克隆繁殖的银鲫雌性遭受更高的寄生虫负荷。
text_en: Compared to genetically variable sexual forms, cloned female crucian carp suffer from higher parasite loads.

quote: Thus, long‐term excessive addition of dietary SO could fail to improve protein retention for more flesh production in gibel carp, as has been demonstrated in some aquatic animals fed high‐fat diets [ 7 , 17 , 18 , 30 , 42 ].
statement: 长期过量添加日粮大豆油可能无法改善银鲫的蛋白质保留以增加产肉量，这在某些饲喂高脂日粮的水生动物中已得到证实。
text_zh: 长期过量添加日粮大豆油可能无法改善银鲫的蛋白质保留以增加产肉量，这在某些饲喂高脂日粮的水生动物中已得到证实。
text_en: Long-term excessive dietary soybean oil supplementation may not improve protein retention in gibel carp to increase meat yield, which has been confirmed in some aquatic animals fed high-fat diets.

quote: Besides more hepatopancreatic insults observed with high dietary SO addition, intestinal pathological damages were evident and clearly dose‐dependent in gibel carp fed SO–based diets
statement: 在高比例大豆油添加下观察到更多的肝胰腺损伤，且以大豆油为基础日粮喂养的银鲫肠道病理损伤明显且呈剂量依赖性。
text_zh: 在高比例大豆油添加下观察到更多的肝胰腺损伤，且以大豆油为基础日粮喂养的银鲫肠道病理损伤明显且呈剂量依赖性。
text_en: More hepatopancreatic damage was observed under high-proportion soybean oil supplementation, and intestinal pathological damage in gibel carp fed soybean oil-based diets was obvious and dose-dependent.

quote: In parallel, serum AST, one sensitive indicator of hepatic damage [ 30 ], was higher in the SO12 group than those in the other groups, suggesting potential hepatic stress in gibel carp with higher dietary SO intake.
statement: SO12组的血清天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）高于其他组，表明高大豆油摄入可能导致银鲫肝脏应激。
text_zh: SO12组的血清天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）高于其他组，表明高大豆油摄入可能导致银鲫肝脏应激。
text_en: The serum aspartate aminotransferase (AST) levels in the SO12 group were higher than those in the other groups, indicating that high soybean oil intake may cause liver stress in gibel carp.

quote: These observations further indicated that an SO–based formula with 12% SO and beyond might metabolically burden the liver and other tissues in gibel carp, thereby leading to physiological and pathological changes strongly linked to metabolism disorders in fish
statement: 这些观察结果表明，含12%及以上大豆油的配方可能会给银鲫的肝脏和其他组织带来代谢负担，从而导致与鱼类代谢紊乱密切相关的生理和病理变化。
text_zh: 这些观察结果表明，含12%及以上大豆油的配方可能会给银鲫的肝脏和其他组织带来代谢负担，从而导致与鱼类代谢紊乱密切相关的生理和病理变化。
text_en: These observations suggest that diets containing 12% or more soybean oil may impose a metabolic burden on the liver and other tissues of silver crucian carp, leading to physiological and pathological changes closely associated with fish metabolic disorders.

quote: However, following 12% dietary SO addition, a marked reduction in serum HDL, combined with the marked rise in serum LDL and T‐CHO to their respective peaks, implied unbalanced fat absorption, metabolism, and transport in gibel carp.
statement: 当饲料中SO添加量达到12%时，血清HDL显著降低，同时血清LDL和总胆固醇升至峰值，表明银鲫的脂肪吸收、代谢和转运失衡。
text_zh: 当饲料中SO添加量达到12%时，血清HDL显著降低，同时血清LDL和总胆固醇升至峰值，表明银鲫的脂肪吸收、代谢和转运失衡。
text_en: When the SO addition level in feed reached 12%, serum HDL decreased significantly, while serum LDL and total cholesterol rose to peak levels, indicating an imbalance in fat absorption, metabolism, and transport in gibel carp.

quote: Based on our data and the relevant results of other studies [ 21 , 54 ], SO–based diets with 12% SO (i.e., 13.93% dietary lipid) or higher SO elicited an overabundance of TG, T‐CHO, and other fat components in the hepatopancreas of gibel carp.
statement: 基于本研究数据及相关文献，含12%或更高比例SO的饲料导致银鲫肝胰腺中甘油三酯、总胆固醇及其他脂肪成分过量积累。
text_zh: 基于本研究数据及相关文献，含12%或更高比例SO的饲料导致银鲫肝胰腺中甘油三酯、总胆固醇及其他脂肪成分过量积累。
text_en: Based on the data from this study and related literature, feed containing 12% or higher proportion of SO led to excessive accumulation of triglycerides, total cholesterol, and other lipid components in the hepatopancreas of gibel carp.

quote: These compounds were unable to fully metabolize, thereby conferring a higher risk related to metabolic disease [ 4 , 17 , 30 , 46 ].
statement: 这些化合物无法被完全代谢，从而增加了患代谢性疾病的风险。
text_zh: 这些化合物无法被完全代谢，从而增加了患代谢性疾病的风险。
text_en: These compounds cannot be fully metabolized, thereby increasing the risk of metabolic diseases.

quote: Fish were euthanized using physical stunning through a blow to the skull with a blunt wooden instrument immediately followed by exsanguination.
statement: 鱼类通过用钝木器击打头部进行物理致晕，随后立即放血以实施安乐死。
text_zh: 鱼类通过用钝木器击打头部进行物理致晕，随后立即放血以实施安乐死。
text_en: Fish are physically stunned by striking the head with a blunt wooden instrument, followed immediately by bleeding to implement euthanasia.

quote: In vitro experiment, the fish muscle tissue was rapidly separated from triploid crucian carp (4.0 ± 0.5) g after anesthetized with 20 mg/L 2-phenoxyethanol.
statement: 在体外实验中，三倍体鲫鱼（4.0 ± 0.5）克经20毫克/升的2-苯氧乙醇麻醉后，迅速分离出鱼肌肉组织。

text_en: In in vitro experiments, triploid crucian carp (4.0 ± 0.5) g were anesthetized with 20 mg/L of 2-phenoxyethanol, and fish muscle tissue was rapidly isolated.

quote: From each fish, fin clip about 1 cm 2 was sampled for ploidy detection.
statement: 从每条鱼身上采集约1平方厘米的鳍片用于倍性检测。
text_zh: 从每条鱼身上采集约1平方厘米的鳍片用于倍性检测。
text_en: About 1 square centimeter of fin clip was collected from each fish for ploidy detection.

quote: All fishes were adapted to the aquaculture conditions for 2 weeks, and the water temperature was controlled at (27.0 ± 0.5)°C and recorded daily.
statement: 鱼类在养殖条件下适应两周，水温控制在(27.0 ± 0.5)°C并每日记录。
text_zh: 鱼类在养殖条件下适应两周，水温控制在(27.0 ± 0.5)°C并每日记录。
text_en: Fish were acclimated for two weeks under farming conditions, with water temperature controlled at (27.0 ± 0.5)°C and recorded daily.

quote: And triploid crucian carp individuals were randomly collected and anesthetized with 20 mg/L 2-phenoxyethanol (Sigma-Aldrich) before dissecting triploid crucian carp to obtain tissue samples.
statement: 三倍体鲫鱼个体被随机采集，并在解剖获取组织样本前使用20 mg/L的2-苯氧乙醇进行麻醉。
text_zh: 三倍体鲫鱼个体被随机采集，并在解剖获取组织样本前使用20 mg/L的2-苯氧乙醇进行麻醉。
text_en: Triploid crucian carp individuals were randomly collected and anesthetized with 20 mg/L of 2-phenoxyethanol before dissection to obtain tissue samples.

quote: And they were stored in a 300 L round glass fiber tank in the indoor circulating fresh water system.
statement: 鱼被饲养在室内循环淡水系统的300升圆形玻璃缸中。
text_zh: 鱼被饲养在室内循环淡水系统的300升圆形玻璃缸中。
text_en: Fish were reared in 300-liter circular glass tanks in an indoor recirculating freshwater system.

quote: Therefore, this study will provide a theoretical basis for establishing a reasonable feeding strategy for cultured fish and improving the umami quality of cultured fish
statement: 本研究为建立养殖鱼类的合理饲养策略和改善其鲜味品质提供了理论基础。
text_zh: 本研究为建立养殖鱼类的合理饲养策略和改善其鲜味品质提供了理论基础。
text_en: This study provides a theoretical basis for establishing reasonable feeding strategies for farmed fish and improving their umami quality.

quote: And the experimental fish were domesticated for 2 weeks, and the domesticated feed was the basic feed.
statement: 实验鱼进行了为期2周的驯化，驯化期间投喂基础饲料。
text_zh: 实验鱼进行了为期2周的驯化，驯化期间投喂基础饲料。
text_en: The experimental fish underwent a 2-week acclimation period, during which they were fed the basal diet.

quote: During domestication, basal diet was fed at 8:30 and 14:30, respectively.
statement: 在驯化期间，分别于8:30和14:30投喂基础日粮。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，分别于8:30和14:30投喂基础日粮。
text_en: During the acclimation period, the basal diet was fed at 8:30 and 14:30 respectively.

quote: After deep anesthesia with MS-222 (200 mg/l), the mucosal (i.e., gill, skin, and intestine) and visceral (i.e., liver, kidney, and spleen) tissue samples were fixed in 10% neutral buffered formalin for at least 24 h
statement: Fish were subjected to deep anesthesia using MS-222 at a concentration of 200 mg/l before tissue sampling for histopathological examination.
text_en: Fish were subjected to deep anesthesia using MS-222 at a concentration of 200 mg/l before tissue sampling for histopathological examination.

quote: Briefly, 0.5 ml of blood was drawn by caudal puncture using a disposable syringe with a 0.7 × 25-mm needle, slightly moistened with diluted heparin solution (5,000 IU heparin in 50 ml of saline, 0.7%), and then immediately utilized for determination of the phagocytic activity.
statement: Blood samples were collected via caudal puncture using a specific needle size and heparinized syringe to assess phagocytic activity.
text_en: Blood samples were collected via caudal puncture using a specific needle size and heparinized syringe to assess phagocytic activity.

quote: In this study, we report on the histopathological and immunohistochemical features of the gills of the crucian carp Carassius auratus challenged with Aeromonas hydrophila .
statement: 本研究报道了受嗜水气单胞菌攻击的鲫鱼鳃的组织病理学和免疫组化特征。
text_zh: 本研究报道了受嗜水气单胞菌攻击的鲫鱼鳃的组织病理学和免疫组化特征。
text_en: This study reported the histopathological and immunohistochemical characteristics of crucian carp gills attacked by Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: Before the experiment, the fish were fasted for 24 h, and the healthy and uniform individuals were selected.
statement: 实验前，鱼禁食24小时，并挑选健康且大小均匀的个体。
text_zh: 实验前，鱼禁食24小时，并挑选健康且大小均匀的个体。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were fasted for 24 hours, and healthy individuals of uniform size were selected.

quote: After weighing, they were randomly placed into 15 fish tanks in the fish room of the laboratory (water temperature: 27.0 ± 0.5°C).
statement: 称重后，将鱼随机放入实验室鱼房的15个鱼缸中（水温：27.0 ± 0.5°C）。
text_zh: 称重后，将鱼随机放入实验室鱼房的15个鱼缸中（水温：27.0 ± 0.5°C）。
text_en: After weighing, the fish were randomly placed into 15 tanks in the laboratory fish room (water temperature: 27.0 ± 0.5°C).
